add.evidence: The real return (i.e. over and above the Consumer Price Index) on investment in the banks' stocks diminished, from a 41% return in 1980, to 34% in 1981, to 28% in 1982.

add.evidence: causing the Knesset State Review Committee to decide on January 7, 1985, to establish a national commission of inquiry

add.event: 贝伊斯基委员会提交调查结论
add.evidence: The commission was headed by Judge Moshe Bejski. The commission presented its findings on April 16, 1986.

add.event: 最高法院下令审判银行经理及向委员会撒谎的会计师
add.evidence: In 1990 the Supreme Court decided to order a trial of the banks' managers, and the accountants who lied to the commission.
